originalTitle: SIF AUM jumps 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June; inflows surge 171% MoM
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news item: Specialised Investment Funds (SIF) had a big increase in the amount of money they managed, with a 29% jump to Rs 17,858 crore in June. This happened because a lot more money was flowing into these funds, with a 171% increase from the previous month. A specific type of SIF, called Hybrid Long-Short Funds, remained very popular. The overall mutual fund industry also saw many investors participating, with a record high in regular investments, which shows that individual investors are still very interested. This is a positive sign for the market, indicating strong investor confidence.

originalTitle: DMart Q1 results: Cons PAT up 11% to Rs 860 crore, revenue rises to Rs 18,795 crore
simplifiedContent: DMart, a retail company, recently shared its financial results for the quarter ending June. The company made a profit of Rs 860 crore, which is 11% more than the same time last year. Its total sales, or revenue, also increased by 14.9% to Rs 18,795 crore. This increase in sales and profit is a positive sign for the company, and its operating efficiency also improved slightly. This matters because it shows how well the company is performing, which can affect its stock price and attractiveness to investors.

originalTitle: Nearly 60% of foreign inflows into India-focused funds withdrawn since 2024 peak: Report
simplifiedContent: Foreign investors have taken out almost 60% of the money they had invested in funds that focus on India's stock market since the peak in 2024. This means they are moving their money to other investments, such as those related to artificial intelligence. In 2026, $9 billion was withdrawn from India-focused funds, showing a significant shift in investor interest. Meanwhile, some investors put money into gold funds and US stocks, and Europe also saw some new investments. This matters because it shows a change in where investors think they can make the most money, and it could impact the Indian stock market.

originalTitle: Nomura sees 22% upside in Ather Energy. Here's why it's the brokerage's top EV pick
simplifiedContent: Nomura, a company that gives opinions on stocks, thinks Ather Energy's stock price will go up by 22%. They believe this because they think many people will start buying electric two-wheelers, and Ather Energy will benefit from this trend. Nomura is saying "buy" Ather Energy's stock, which means they think it's a good investment. They've also increased their target price for the stock to ₹1,470, which is the price they think it will reach. This makes Ather Energy Nomura's top pick for electric vehicle companies.

originalTitle: Why large cap and mid cap funds could be the best mutual fund to bet on now, according to Abakkus study
simplifiedContent: A recent study by Abakkus Mutual Fund found that large cap and mid cap funds might be a good investment choice right now. This is because company earnings are improving and the prices of these funds are reasonable. The stock market has recently gone down, which can be a good opportunity for long-term investors to get in. This means that the prices of stocks might start to match the growth in company earnings, making it a potentially good time to invest. The study suggests that now could be a good time to put money into large cap and mid cap funds.

originalTitle: AI chip fever returns? SK Hynix  share price surges 13% after blockbuster $26.5 billion US listing
simplifiedContent: SK Hynix, a company that makes computer chips, just listed its shares on the US stock market and raised a lot of money - $26.5 billion. The company's share price jumped up 13% on its first day, which is a big increase. This suggests that investors are very interested in companies that make chips for artificial intelligence (AI). The strong demand for AI-related technology is driving up the price of these chips, which is why investors are excited about companies like SK Hynix. This is notable because other similar companies have seen their stock prices fluctuate recently, but SK Hynix's successful listing shows that investors are still confident in the sector.
